text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
choice_data_list: Were you not able to get much rest?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No...
It was such a fulfilling day...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "When I offered to give feng shui advice for people's worries, way more people showed up than I expected..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I stayed up diagnosing everyone from my room,
and before I knew it, morning had come~... Ehehe~...
Copano Rickey looked happy, but she seemed a little sleep-deprived.
